# The packages published to nuget.org, one package ID per line.
#
# This is the set that IsPackable=true in src/, and it is deliberately NOT "everything under
# src/". Alberto.Admin and Alberto.Admin.Postgres build and are tested but are parked — see the
# admin-surface note in CLAUDE.md. Scripts that walk public API must use this list rather than a
# src/* glob, or they will treat the parked surface as shipping API: Alberto.Admin carries a
# 327-line PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt that must never be promoted to Shipped.
#
# Blank lines and #-comments are ignored by readers.
#
# ADDING A PACKAGE TAKES TWO EDITS. This file, and the literal allowlist in the "Verify packed
# set" step of .github/workflows/publish-packages.yml. That second copy is deliberate — it is the
# independent check that a new nuget.org listing, which can never be deleted or reclaimed, was
# written down twice on purpose. The comment on that step explains why it is not consolidated
# here. Editing only this file packs the new package and then fails the publish job on the diff.

Alberto
Alberto.Commands
Alberto.EntityFramework
Alberto.InMemory
Alberto.Messaging
Alberto.Messaging.Postgres
Alberto.Postgres
Alberto.Telemetry
Alberto.Testing
Alberto.Testing.Xunit
